# appdynamics_synthetic_api_application (Data Source)

Retrieves the detail (including app_key) of one Synthetic API Monitoring application by ID. Shares its type name with the managed resource -- resource "appdynamics_synthetic_api_application" and data "appdynamics_synthetic_api_application" are separate namespaces.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "appdynamics_synthetic_api_application" "checkout_api" {
  application_id = "10499"
}

output "checkout_api_key" {
  value = data.appdynamics_synthetic_api_application.checkout_api.app_key
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `application_id` (String) ID of the application to retrieve.

### Read-Only

- `app_key` (String)
- `name` (String)
